files.role: Public V2_3 composition module. It selects an ordered field-encoder and page-mechanism policy, reexports its exact reader/writer surface, and delegates physical column mapping to shared structural code.
ranges: SPDX/version docs/imports mirror structural V2_2 selection plus AtomicBool/Ordering. Private compression/reader/writer own exact mechanisms. Arc shares policies and ReadProjection; object Writer is consumed only by factory calls.

Metadata decode/finish/index/global-buffer reexports are pub(crate); projection constructors and Writer public. read_projection composes shared structural engine with V2_3 reader::decode_column. Private process static WARNED_ON_UNSTABLE_FORMAT starts false; it is not per-writer, per-file or persistent configuration.
Public physical_column_count/data_file_columns and pub(super) field_id_to_column_index directly delegate shared leaf mapping. This module adds no separate column numbering or checked arithmetic.

Private Debug FieldStrategy owns primitive. Trait create_field_encoder tries binary Blob then structural Blob, propagating errors and returning first Some. Mutable column-index state is shared across candidates; no rollback is added here.

Unhandled Blob returns InvalidInput with name/datatype. Map then structural fixed-size-list then primitive are tried in that exact order, each short-circuiting. These helper names identify delegation, not universal type support.
Try list then struct, finally NotSupported identifying Lance v2.3/field/datatype. No data compression or asynchronous work is performed in this dispatcher itself.

encoding_strategy consumes tuning into Arc<compression::Strategy>, gives an Arc clone to sparse mechanism, then adds constant() with no compression argument and gives the original compression Arc to dense_u32. Only sparse and dense share this policy Arc. Ordered page choices are sparse, constant, dense_u32; no reject_sparse mechanism. Construction does not emit instability warning.

warn_unstable_format compare_exchange(false,true,Relaxed,Relaxed) makes at most one caller execute log::warn per process static lifetime; failed exchanges are ignored. Relaxed ordering is adequate for warning deduplication and publishes no other state. Warning says development/experimentation only and future unreadability; static becomes true even if logs filtered or later writer creation fails.

Eager create_writer and create_writer_with_compression call warning before corresponding fallible Writer factory. Warning is neither a format rejection nor evidence of successful file creation. Inputs moved, errors propagate. Direct use of public Writer or footer helpers is not guarded by these wrapper calls.
Lazy create_writer variants also warn before concrete infallible new_lazy methods, with/without explicit tuning. They can log before any batch/schema/file output exists.
Self-described and mini batch helpers call exact concat_lance_footer true/false and do not call warn_unstable_format. Both return Result<Bytes>; no inline tests or unsafe code.
files.limits: Every physical line was read in ANALYZE53. No source execution/build/test was performed. Exact version reader/writer bodies and compression/encoder helper internals remain separately pending; delegated calls are not evidence of their full behavior.

files.role: Exact-version composition root for projection, metadata, reader and writer dispatch. It accepts ConcreteFileVersion after caller selector resolution and separates V1 compatibility from current-format runtime APIs.
ranges: SPDX/module guidance prefers statically known version submodules and one exhaustive runtime dispatch. Imports core schema/errors/cache, bytes, encoding metadata/plugins/batches, scheduler/Writer, BTreeMap/Future/Arc and reader/writer types. Public modules are v1,v2_0,v2_1,v2_2,v2_3. No numeric version ordering or release-alias resolution occurs here.

Crate-visible read_projection returns Internal for V1 with current reader composition received Lance v1. Each V2 variant obtains its own module projection as Arc<dyn ReadProjection>. No fallback to a newer grammar.

Public OpenedFileReader has V1{major_version:u16,minor_version:u16}, retaining literal footer numbers for diagnostics, and Current(FileReader). V1 carries no opened legacy reader. No derive or third variant.

Crate-visible finish_metadata consumes RawFileMetadata and dispatches to exact V2 module; V1 returns Internal current metadata dispatch received a Lance v1 file. Ownership/error cleanup are ordinary Rust drops; no retry or IO in this wrapper.

validate_external_metadata builds a whole-schema projection for the requested exact version, rejects physical-column count mismatch as InvalidInput with expected/actual counts, then invokes FileReader::validate_projection. Require each ColumnInfo.index to equal its enumerate index as u32 or InvalidInput. Clone metadata column_infos into PreparedProjection and ask exact read_projection.read_length. No direct page-byte read or independent row-count arithmetic. Contextual validate_projection rejects zero schema fields, duplicate column indices and out-of-bounds indices (rust/lance-file/src/reader.rs:1117-1144); grammar-specific rectangularity remains delegated.

finish_metadata_index dispatches using index.version; V1 gives VersionConflict with numeric0,2 and message about current reader with v1 metadata index. That diagnostic uses canonical legacy footer numbers, not a preserved original alias. V2 modules own accepted metadata-index grammar.

decode_column_metadata takes exact version and protobuf slice, returning Vec<Arc<ColumnInfo>> via exact module. V1 is NotSupported because self-described batches are outside its grammar. Decoder/plugin/page validation is delegated, not implemented here.

validate_global_buffers dispatches V2 checks; V1 returns Ok(()) without examining the descriptors. This exception is not a promise that current-format global buffers can be written/read through V1 APIs.

Public reader_projection_from_field_ids delegates each of all five exact versions to its schema/BTreeMap<u32,u32> builder and wraps the returned ReaderProjection in Ok. No local error path or mapping validation; delegated builders may have their own assumptions. Argument order is version,schema,map.

Public reader_projection_from_whole_schema is infallible in its signature and dispatches all five modules. Its argument order is schema,version, unlike the neighboring projection helpers. Exact physical column layout remains module-defined.
Public reader_projection_from_column_names accepts version,schema,&[&str], delegates all five versions and propagates Result. Missing names and nesting rules belong to concrete builders.

physical_column_count returns usize for one core Field via each exact grammar. data_file_columns returns (Vec<i32>,Vec<i32>) persisted field-to-column entries via each module. No local range checks, normalization or format policy beyond exhaustive matching.

copy_external_metadata_column takes FnOnce()->Send Future<Result<()>>. V1 returns NotSupported and never calls the closure. V2_0 calls only if its schema/index/has-existing-pages predicate allows; otherwise successful no-op. V2_1/2/3 unconditionally call and await once. Closure failure propagates; cancellation does not roll back partial IO here. The concrete V2_0 predicate is now covered: recognized nonpacked logical struct header is skipped when pages already exist; unknown target is treated as nonheader (rust/lance-file/src/versions/v2_0/mod.rs:84-115).

finalize_external_metadata_column takes mutable Vec<PageInfo> and row count. V1 NotSupported; V2_0 calls its infallible normalizer then returns Ok; V2_1/2/3 return Ok without mutating pages. No rollback or byte writes occur in this root.

open_projected_reader: V1 NotSupported without opening either closure; V2_0 always awaits open_full, ignoring prefer_indexed/projection. V2_1/2/3 try open_indexed only when prefer_indexed and FileMetadataProvider::projection_matches_indexed_metadata. Some(reader) returns immediately; None falls back to open_full; Err propagates without fallback. Both closures are FnOnce and Send futures; no concurrent opens. Contextual predicate rejects empty schema and compares checked grammar-count sum to column-index length (rust/lance-file/src/reader.rs:1542-1555), not selectivity alone.

open_self_described_reader takes FileScheduler,Arc<DecoderPlugins>,borrowed LanceCache,FileReaderOptions and awaits FileReader::try_open_for_dispatch with None metadata. Docs say its optimistic tail read detects exact identity without a separate footer probe; actual IO/caching costs require reader analysis. Returned enum retains V1 detection rather than constructing a v1 writer/reader here.

create_writer consumes object writer,schema,options, matching exact V2 create_writer and mapping successful concrete writers into FileWriter. V1 NotSupported directs callers to versions::v1::writer::FileWriter with its manifest provider. No local option validation; each concrete creator owns it. Error drops moved inputs; underlying Writer drop/abort guarantees remain pending.

create_lazy_writer consumes object writer/options with no schema. V1 NotSupported says explicit schema/manifest provider required. V2 lazy creators are wrapped in Ok and converted into the corresponding FileWriter variant. Root performs no option/schema validation, IO or first-batch initialization.

encode_self_described_batch and encode_mini_batch borrow EncodedBatch and dispatch to exact V2 encoder Result<Bytes>; V1 returns separate NotSupported messages. No automatic alias resolution or batch-version reconciliation occurs in this root; concrete format framing is pending.

Single cfg(test) case constructs empty EncodedBatch (empty data/page table/schema/top-level columns,0rows) and asserts both embedded encoders reject V1 with Error::NotSupported. Messages, V2 bytes, other V1 rejection methods and indexed-open fallback branches are not tested locally. No tests executed.
